items.title: KC Concepcion: Remains productive in Week 4 win
items.body_text: Concepcion secured five of eight targets for 64 yards and returned two punts for 10 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Steelers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Continues thriving in Week 4 win
items.body_text: Boston brought in four of seven targets for 89 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Steelers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Harold Fannin: Salvages night with TD
items.body_text: Fannin secured three of five targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Steelers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Continues ascent with third straight win
items.body_text: Watson completed 24 of 33 passes for 268 yards with one touchdown and one interception while rushing seven times for 22 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Steelers on Thursday. He also committed two fumbles, losing one. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Mixed performance in Week 4 loss
items.body_text: Rodgers completed 22 of 40 passes for 299 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions in the Steelers' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Thursday. He also ran in a game-tying two-point conversion. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
